_comment: Model registry. 'priority' is the global fallback order used when a course does not pin its own list in course.json 'models'. Each entry: ctx = context window to request (RAM-bound, not the model's max), flags = extra llama-server flags. All models must be Q4_K_M-class quants that fit 16 GB RAM CPU-only.

gemma-4-E4B-it-Q4_K_M.gguf.notes: Apr 2026, dense, thinking off by default. Validated 25/25 on DV Lab eval banks (June 2026). Current safe default.

Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf.notes: JetBrains, May 2026. MoE 12B total / 2.5B active - fast on CPU. LiveCodeBench v6 69.9 (vs Gemma 4 E4B ~52). Answers directly, no chain of thought. NOT yet eval-validated for this course - run eval/run_eval.py before making it primary.

Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf.notes: Mar 2026, dense 9B, strongest reasoning per GB (GPQA 81.7). Thinking DISABLED via --reasoning-budget 0 (needs llama.cpp >= b8148; the old enable_thinking chat-template kwarg does NOT work). Dense 9B is slow on this CPU (~5-7 tok/s) - use only if quality gaps show up that Mellum/Gemma can't close.

Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf.notes: Nov 2024 legacy code specialist. Fallback only.
